$comment: The macOS 27 light RECEDED endpoint, as a difference over
apple-macos-27.0-1x-light-standard-glass0.5.json — W29 G3b, Decision Log 6 (d).
It is a CALIBRATION profile document and not a runtime constant. The runtime
still ships the 26.5 endpoints in packages/platform-web/src/receded-profile.ts;
selecting a 27 endpoint is W29 G4's by Decision Log 2. This document is posed
on the inactive scenes through `compare --receded-profile`, which merges it
over the active document and pins the root active, and the cell's capturePath
carries its hash so a row says which endpoint drew it.
Fitted on the seventeen inactive CALIBRATION rows of
apple-macos-27.0-1x-light-standard-glass0.5 at dpr 1 and checked on validation.
One caveat is recorded in claims §5.154 rather than hidden here: the response's
first ordinate is identified by no UNTINTED calibration cell — the bed's only
calibration cell at that abscissa is tinted — and it was moved on the two
untinted `impulse` VALIDATION cells before that was noticed, so for that one
ordinate those two cells are not an independent check.
W30 G3 (claims §5.159) moves this block's seven amplitude leaves with the
active document's, leaf for leaf — on macOS 27 the recede KEEPS the outer
shadow rather than removing it (claims §5.154 §5), so the receded pose casts
the active document's shadow at the receded document's own amplitudes. The σ
law's three leaves are NOT named here: a receded document is a difference over
the active document of its own scheme and `withMaterialOverrides` merges the
`outerShadow` block leaf by leaf, so a leaf this document does not name is the
active document's own. One law, one copy.

measurement.fixtures: apps/reference-apple/fixtures/apple-macos-27.0-1x-light-standard-glass0.5, the inactive rows of the W29 G1 bed at seven runs per cell, slider 0.5
measurement.fixtureSets: calibration; validation checked; holdout read once at the sealed configuration and never fitted
measurement.webCell: chromium, renderer webgpu, samplingBackend gpu-texture, adapter apple/metal-3, posed through compare --receded-profile
measurement.objective: mean over the inactive rows of |Δ interiorMean|, with the shadow read as |Δ meanDeparture|

method: The anchors move to the 27 ACTIVE document's, [0.004, 0.11, 0.425, 0.95],
and that is the load-bearing half of this fit. W28's anchors start at 0.1104
because the 26.5 bed's uniform backdrops start there; the 27 active refit
moved the first knot to the darkest backdrop there is (§5.153 §2 item 1) and
the recede has to follow it. While it did not, every cell over `impulse`
clamped to an ordinate no cell identified and rendered 0.4612 against a
reference of 0.2323 — a fifth of the whole residual, on two cells, and
immovable by any value of that ordinate. Re-anchoring alone took the bed-wide
residual from 0.0433 to 0.0213.
The ordinates are then the native inactive level read at each anchor, because
the rendered level tracks the response ordinate to within 0.02 on this
material: 0.2823 over `dark-solid`, 0.4955-0.4975 over the photograph, 0.8310
over `light-solid`. Two iterations of the residual close the rest.
The 27 light recede is nearly THICKNESS-INDEPENDENT, which the 26.5 one is
not: its thin and thick rows differ by 0.44 at the dark anchor (0.0126 against
0.4553) and by 0.02 here. That is the same convergence §5.153 §2 found in the
active light document, arriving in the pose.

outerShadow.status: measured — the recede no longer removes the shadow
outerShadow.previous: every amplitude leaf zero (W27c G1, claims §5.130)
outerShadow.method: See `theRecedeNoLongerRemovesTheShadow` in fitted-receded.json. The block is this document's own active document's, leaf for leaf; the residual over the eight identified inactive cells is 0.00045 mean absolute at a signed mean of +0.00009.

method: W31's chroma retention (claims §5.161 §5, fitted in §5.164 §4). How much of
the blurred backdrop's CHROMATICITY the body restores, at the luma the tone
solve produced. Fitted per SCHEME and per POSE: this document is the
light scheme's inactive endpoint and carries its own value, because the four
beds read 0.551 / 0.514 / 0.333 / 0.584 before the fit and are not one number.
Objective: R = chromaStructureRatioWeb / chromaStructureRatioNative, web
against native on the same cell and never against 1, median over the untinted
`photo` cells of the four macOS 27 standard profiles at both scales — 8 cells
on this bed — `calibration` + `validation`, WebGPU tier, holdout dropped by
construction in the fit loop's own reader. Bound 0.80 ≤ median R ≤ 1.20 with a
per-cell floor of 0.60, two-sided because an over-fitted retention adds chroma
the reference does not have.
Two rounds. Round A probed one point and measured the bed's slope; round B
solved it. R moves 0.5137 → 1.0205 on this bed, inside the bound and
inside the instrument's own 1x-against-2x reproducibility (4.5 % light, 9.1 %
dark), which is why there is no round C: a third would be fitting noise.
Both hard stops held with margin on every cell of the bed. The LEVEL stop —
|interiorMeanWeb − interiorMeanNative| ≤ 0.055, growing by no more than 0.005
from its pre-fit value — reads a worst |Δ| of 0.04932 and a worst growth of
+0.00006, eighty times inside the clause that binds, because the operator is
luma-preserving by construction. The STRUCTURE stop — interiorStdDevWeb within
2 % of its pre-fit value — reads a worst 1.317 %, on the bed's smallest
spread, and that residual is the capture's own 8-bit quantisation rather than
the operator: the movement scales inversely with the cell's spread.
The CSS tier carries NOTHING of this constant. A derived term was written,
rendered and declined on the measurement (§5.164 §5): on the dark bed it
bought nothing at all, and on the light bed it broke both stops.
